description.de: Generisches Schema für die Szenen-Matrix eines WINDI-HIOS-Films.
description.en: Generic schema for the scene matrix of a WINDI-HIOS film.
description.pt: Schema genérico para a matriz de cenas de um filme WINDI-HIOS.

scene_contract.scene: string  // canonical scene id, e.g. S07
scene_contract.timecode: string  // SRT in/out from source cut
scene_contract.world_state_ref: string  // MUST reference a sealed WORLD-STATE id
scene_contract.location: string  // named location token, consistent across scenes
characters: string  // anchor_ref ids from CONTINUITY-BIBLE / §293 only
scene_contract.continuity_parent: string|null  // previous scene id this must visually follow
scene_contract.windi_on_screen: boolean  // does the WINDI Ledger UI appear in frame

validation_rules: Every characters[] entry MUST exist in CONTINUITY-BIBLE-001 or §293 SPINE-CAST.
world_state_ref MUST point to a sealed WORLD-STATE instance.
continuity_parent MUST reference an earlier scene (no forward refs).
windi_on_screen=true scenes MUST render the integrity readout + receipt/hash.
No scene may introduce a location contradicting world_state jurisdiction.
